newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche sells plant, nine products to ICN.
newsitem.headline: Roche sells plant, nine products to ICN.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said it agreed to sell its Humacao plant in Puerto Rico and nine prescription pharmaceutical products to ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc in a deal valued at a net $145 million.
Under the agreement, which is subject to regulatory approvals, Roche is selling the plant in Puerto Rico, seven products and rights outside the U.S. for two more products.
The company anticipates closing the sale on August 1, 1997.

Roche said the deal also calls for it to continue to operate the plant for two years and until ICN has build up its own production and distribution capacities, continue to manufacture and distribute the nine products involved in the transaction.
Sales of the products covered by the agreement totalled $55 million in 1996, Roche also said.
The company also said that, to bridge-finance the transaction, it will be partly paid in ICN shares.

Roche provided no details on the products being sold, but said the transaction was in line with Roche's strategy to streamline its product portfolio and improve efficiency of its manufacturing operations.
